items.title: Healthy Change Plan. New edition! Starts 11 May.

Training schedule: Mon 8:30 PM, Wed 8:30 PM, Fri 7:30 PM.

Join our community on Instagram and Facebook.
items.detail: Simple, effective exercises you can use right away. Tips for staying active every day. Inspiring stories from fellow members. Ideas for improving posture, mobility and strength. Support and motivation to power your every day.

items.title: Functional assessment at a special price.
items.detail: Your first meeting with a trainer is a functional assessment. Through a few simple exercises, the trainer identifies what's already working well and what needs attention in training. This assessment is for you and your trainer — it helps build your training plan and track your progress. Right now you can get a functional assessment at a special price!

FriendlySpace.heading: A friendly space.
FriendlySpace.body: BODYWORK® is a playground for your body. An open space with free weights, functional equipment, a running track and resistance machines — everything you need for physical preparation and rehabilitation. It's complemented by medical and dietetic consulting rooms, a biomechanics lab, a recovery zone with sauna and massage, and a healthy-food bar with meals composed by our dietitians.

Statements.movementTool: Movement is our most important tool.
Statements.teachPotentialHeading: We teach you how to use your body's potential wisely and effectively.
Statements.teachPotentialBody: We develop the key elements of fitness that translate into better health, physique and sporting results. Every programme is built individually, grounded in current medical knowledge, to prevent injury, reduce pain and grow your body's potential.
Statements.healthProcessHeading: We believe health isn't a state — it's a process.
Statements.healthProcessBody: It's a dynamic balance of many elements: body, genetics, mind, social relationships, resilience to stress, recovery and the quality of what you eat. It's a conscious approach to prevention — regularly monitoring functional parameters, check-ups, and reacting quickly to warning signs. It takes commitment, attention and smart choices.

Team.heading: Team.
Team.body: Our team is made up of top-class specialists working within a medical and sports training concept, complemented by modern manual therapy methods and dietetics. They bring knowledge and skills drawn from professional sport, rehabilitation and coaching. Using BODYWORK's own personal-development system, they'll help you achieve the results you're after.

items.quote: A gym for people who don't like “the gym”, the stereotypical place for bodybuilders. A very pleasant space, a professional approach. A competent and committed team. Added huge value to my life. Recommended.

BodyWork is a place you genuinely want to come back to. An intimate studio, well organised and welcoming to everyone, whatever your level. For over two years I trained with Martyna, the best trainer I've ever worked with — professional, committed, hugely knowledgeable and great to work with. I recommend it wholeheartedly!

Body Work is the best place I could have found. Built by people with passion, for people who need help or want to improve their quality of life. Professionalism, empathy, smiles, and a guaranteed great atmosphere. The workouts are demanding, but they keep me progressing. I recommend it to everyone.
A pleasant place, a professional team. Training here is genuinely enjoyable.
A great, intimate place where you'll get full support from expert trainers. Special thanks to Dominika, who helped me reach my sporting goal.
